note_en: 凡是…都… means "anyone/anything that… without exception": 凡是走进鼎泰丰的人，都能看到… "Anyone who walks into Din Tai Fung can see…" 凡是 opens the subject and 都 before the verb sums it up; English says it once with "anyone who," but Chinese needs both halves.
